content: MSAL Python 1.39.0 public API is limited to msal/__init__.py documented methods. ConfidentialClientApplication supports client_secret string, authority, token_cache. initiate_auth_code_flow supports scopes, redirect_uri, state, prompt, login_hint, domain_hint, max_age, response_mode=form_post, returns auth_uri/state and internal flow data. acquire_token_by_auth_code_flow validates response including nonce; acquire_token_by_authorization_code accepts nonce; acquire_token_silent/acquire_token_silent_with_error use persisted cache; remove_account forgets account from cache.
